svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Same shaky hand, before and after Calmcursor
svg.desc: A simulated 5.4 Hz tremor of about 6 pixels. The raw path zig-zags; the steadied path is smooth and holds still during clicks.
svg.text: Same shaky hand, before and after Calmcursor
A simulated 5.4 Hz tremor (about ±6 px) run through the real Calmcursor engine at steadiness 50.
Close-up of one click (×7): the pointer holds still.
Shake at rest: 4.0 px → 0.9 px (77% less)
